stance: The Web Bot Auth effort is maturing from defining core verification rules into standardizing client-side feedback loops.
adoption_shape: Movement remains concentrated within the standards body rather than broader market adoption, with momentum defined by an expanding corpus of 14 active and related IETF specifications.
new_entrants: Contributor Suresh has introduced draft-suresh-webbotauth-verification-outcome-00 to control how servers relay authentication outcomes back to visiting clients.
watch_for: Working-group consensus on adopting the individual Suresh verification-outcome proposal into the formal Web Bot Auth standards track.
